quote:
You carry heavy grief inside your quiet chest.
People walk away without looking back at you.
You try to hold the pieces together alone.
Nights grow cold while the world sleeps on.
Love should never feel like a constant war.
Sometimes letting go is the bravest choice left.
Your broken heart deserves healing in the end.
